tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background under everything; watercolour washes are painted on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inroads' bubbles, plain cards, row lists, the one input, sheets, the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: a draft inside a plain card, skeletons, the trust-level track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on every ground and tint: 16.3:1 on paper and 15.2:1 on peach (light); 16.1:1 and 12.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Reasons, meta, hints, timestamps. 5.7:1 on paper, 6.2:1 on surface, 5.3:1 on peach, 5.5:1 on butter (light); 7.8:1, 7.1:1, 5.9:1, 5.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around the tab bar. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-control borders when one is needed: 3.5:1 (light) and 3.2:1 (dark) on surface.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The one action colour and Inroads' own colour: primary buttons, the Inroads mark, your own bubbles, links, the focus ring, the ready banner. 6.1:1 on surface (light), 7.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blue fill: 6.2:1 (light), 7.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for things Inroads is doing or planning, selected filters, icon wells.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Text and labels on blue-soft (7.8:1 light, 8.0:1 dark); the pressed shade of blue.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Tint for moments about people: a new role, a birthday, someone new, overdue promises.

tokens.name: on-peach
tokens.usage: Reason tags and labels on peach (6.4:1 light, 9.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Tint for intros and for your own notes and quotes.

tokens.name: on-butter
tokens.usage: Labels on butter (6.4:1 light, 9.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Tint for done and kept: sent confirmations, promises kept, a warm relationship.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Labels on mint (5.5:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Tint for meetings and events.

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: Avatar fill and the Inbox count badge. Not for text.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Strength bar fill and avatar fill. As text only at 13px semibold and up (4.5:1 light, 9.0:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Avatar fill.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Celebration and the painted sun in watercolour scenes. Never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete and errors, always with the word. 6.5:1 (light) and 7.5:1 (dark) on surface.

tokens.name: wash-sky
tokens.usage: Watercolour pigment: the cool wash at the top of the Brief and in scenes.

tokens.name: wash-peach
tokens.usage: Watercolour pigment: the warm wash.

tokens.name: wash-sage
tokens.usage: Watercolour pigment: hills and the green wash.

tokens.name: wash-sand
tokens.usage: Watercolour pigment: distant hills and paper warmth.

tokens.name: space-work
tokens.usage: Dot for the Work Space.

tokens.name: space-personal
tokens.usage: Dot for the Personal Space.

tokens.name: space-dating
tokens.usage: Dot for the Dating Space.

tokens.name: space-other
tokens.usage: Dot for Spaces you create.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The Brief's greeting; the name may be blue. One per screen.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Big friendly numbers: things ready, intros this week.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Screen titles and a person's name.

styles.name: story
styles.sample: You met at Lagos Startup Week and have spoken six times since.
styles.usage: The relationship story at the top of a person page.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: She joined Kestrel Ventures as Partner.

styles.name: tag
styles.sample: New role · 40 days since you spoke
styles.usage: Reason tags on tinted cards, in the matching on- colour.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and the date line, uppercase.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Times, days and counts in rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and buttons; bubbles in a thread.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside rows and chips; between a card's parts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards in the Inbox.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Room above the greeting, where the wash shows.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The corner of a bubble nearest its speaker; small marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Drafts, notes, inputs, skeleton bars.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, row lists, the ready banner, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, avatars, the one input.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Plain surface cards, bubbles, row lists. Tinted cards have no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The one input and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card being dragged or swiped.

duration.note: Motion timing. Reduced motion swaps all of these for a 120ms fade and stops loops.

tokens.name: dur-tap
tokens.usage: Press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hovers, chips, toggles.

tokens.name: dur-arrive
tokens.usage: A bubble, card or banner arriving.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: A card leaving after approve or skip.

tokens.name: dur-bloom
tokens.usage: Watercolour bloom spreading after an approve or a win.

tokens.name: dur-fill
tokens.usage: Strength bars and progress filling.

tokens.name: dur-breathe
tokens.usage: One breath of the Inroads mark while it works.

tokens.name: dur-drift
tokens.usage: One slow drift of a background wash.

easing.note: One curve with a gentle overshoot for arrivals; one calm curve for the rest.

tokens.name: ease-arrive
tokens.usage: Arrivals: bubbles, cards, the count, toasts.

tokens.name: ease-calm
tokens.usage: Exits, fills, blooms, drifts, hovers.
